title: Approximate tangent planes of a bi-Lipschitz Lipschitz image
statement: Let F : ℝ^n → ℝ^P be L-Lipschitz, B ⊆ ℝ^n Borel and m > 0 with m|a − a'| ≤ |F(a) − F(a')| for a, a' ∈ B. Suppose F is differentiable with injective derivative at every point of B. Then for Lebesgue-a.e. b ∈ B, F(B) has approximate tangent space range DF(b) at F(b): HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n (F '' B) (F b) (range DF(b)).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (F : Euclid n → Euclid P) (B : Set (Euclid n)) (L : NNReal) (m : ℝ), LipschitzWith L F → MeasurableSet B → 0 < m → (∀ a ∈ B, ∀ a' ∈ B, m * ‖a - a'‖ ≤ ‖F a - F a'‖) → (∀ a ∈ B, DifferentiableAt ℝ F a ∧ Injective (fderiv ℝ F a)) → ∀ᵐ b ∂(volume.restrict B), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n (F '' B) (F b) (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ F b : Euclid n →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P))
